text.name: Whetstone
text.desc: +2 attack.

lore.flavour: Every dawn it whispers the same word: sharper.
lore.activation: Hones the edge again: +1 ATK this floor.
lore.awake: Strikes ignore enemy DEF.

text.name: Ox Heart
text.desc: +13 max HP, heal 13.

lore.flavour: Two sizes too big. Still warm.
lore.awake: Also heals 2 at each floor's gate.

text.name: Debt of Flesh
text.desc: Every time you spend gold, heal 10. Any spend — rerolls, the bazaar, tolls.
text.flavor: The body remembers every coin that leaves.

lore.flavour: The body remembers every coin that leaves.
lore.awake: The debt pays double: heal 20.

text.name: Coin Magnet
text.desc: Loose coins drop +1 gold.

lore.flavour: Gold remembers where it belongs.
lore.passive: Kill loot and coin spills: +1 gold each.

text.name: Alchemist's Vial
text.desc: When you gain gold: heal 1.

lore.flavour: Gold in, mercy out.

text.name: Blood Altar
text.desc: When you heal: deal 2 damage.

lore.flavour: It tithes in blood — the enemy's.
lore.awake: Its blood also feeds you: heals 1 when it strikes.

text.name: Thorn Vest
text.desc: When hit: deal 2 back.

lore.flavour: Go on, it dares. Hug me.
lore.native: Fires when you take a hit.

text.name: Vampire Tooth
text.desc: When you attack: heal 1.

lore.flavour: Still hungry after all these years.
lore.native: Fires on every strike you land.
lore.awake: Drains the ceiling: each bite takes 1 max HP from the foe.

text.name: Midas Blade
text.desc: On pickup: +1 attack per 60 gold in the purse (now +{n}).

lore.flavour: A king's greed, bottled and sold on.
lore.passive: On pickup: +1 ATK per 50 gold in the purse.
lore.awake: Recounts live: +1 ATK per 50g at all times.

text.name: Greedy Curse
text.desc: Gold gains doubled. Hits hurt +1.

lore.flavour: It pays well. It collects better.
lore.native: Fires when you take a hit.
lore.awake: The extra hurt is charged to your purse: 2 gold per point, not HP.

text.name: Swift Boots
text.desc: Attack 25% faster.

lore.flavour: They never touch the same stone twice.
lore.activation: A burst of pace: +2 SPD this floor.
lore.awake: Every 4th strike is instant.

text.name: Battle Dash
text.desc: You strike first in every fight.

lore.flavour: The fight starts before they blink.
lore.passive: You strike first on each floor's opening fight.
lore.activation: A burst of pace: +2 SPD this floor.
lore.awake: Opens every fight.

text.name: Lucky Clover
text.desc: Unlocks evasion: dodge enemy attacks at LCK%. Also +10 LCK.

lore.flavour: Four leaves. One promise it never states.
lore.passive: Unlocks evasion: dodge enemy attacks at LCK%. Also +15 LCK.
lore.native: Fires when an enemy misses you.
lore.activation: Releases a luck signal into the chain.
lore.awake: Dodges release luck signals.

text.name: Iron Skin
text.desc: +2 DEF. Hits land softer.

lore.flavour: Skin like a rumor — hard to pierce.
lore.awake: The first hit each fight glances off.

text.name: Adrenaline Gland
text.desc: First hit taken each floor: +1 attack, permanently.

lore.flavour: Pain is just ignition.
lore.passive: First hit each floor: +1 ATK, permanent.
lore.native: Fires on the first hit you take each floor.
lore.awake: Fires on the first hit of every fight.

text.name: Piggy Bank
text.desc: Cash out for 25% more gold.

lore.flavour: Fatter every floor. Never full.

text.name: Berserker Charm
text.desc: +4 attack while below half HP.

lore.flavour: It only speaks when you bleed.
lore.awake: Bloodied: also +25% attack speed.

text.name: Rabbit’s Foot
text.desc: Each lucky break: +1 LCK this floor. In versus: every 3rd.

lore.flavour: Unlucky for the rabbit. Lucky for you.
lore.awake: Fires on every signal, even in the arena.

text.name: Cutpurse Hook
text.desc: Doubles loose-coin spill odds; spills pay +1 gold per copy.

lore.flavour: It steals mid-swing, and swears it didn't.
lore.passive: Doubles loose-coin spill odds; spills pay +1 per copy.
lore.native: Spills are lucky breaks — luck relics react.
lore.awake: Every strike spills — no roll.

text.name: Weighted Dice
text.desc: +5 LCK. Your strikes may crit for 1.5× damage. Crit chance = [[LCK]].

lore.flavour: Loaded? Prove it.
lore.passive: Strikes may crit for 1.5× damage (LCK% chance).
lore.native: Every crit is a lucky break — luck relics react.
lore.awake: Crits hit ×2.

text.name: Troll Marrow
text.desc: While below half HP, every hit you take knits back 2 per copy.
text.flavor: It remembers how to grow back — when it must.
text.passive: Bloodied: heal 2 after every hit taken.

lore.flavour: It remembers how to grow back — when it must.
lore.passive: Bloodied: heal 2 after every hit taken.
lore.awake: Knits from the foe: every stitch is drained from their HP.

text.name: Second Stomach
text.desc: Between-floor breathers heal double.
text.flavor: Always room for one more meal.

lore.flavour: Always room for one more meal.
lore.awake: Breathers also +1 max HP.

text.name: Martyr's Knot
text.desc: Heals from relics restore +1 more per copy.

lore.flavour: Tied once, it gives forever.
lore.awake: Bears it for you: 1 in 3 hits is redirected to the foe entirely.

text.name: Blood Pact
text.desc: Signing costs 20 HP — and 20% of it again every round in versus; +5 ATK, permanent.
text.flavor: Sign here. And here. And bleed here.
text.passive: -20 HP (versus: -20% max HP per round); +5 ATK forever.

lore.flavour: Sign here. And here. And bleed here.
lore.passive: -20 HP (versus: -20% max HP per round); +5 ATK forever.
lore.awake: The pact pays +8 ATK.

text.name: Gravekeeper's Soil
text.desc: Once per run: refuse death, rise at 25% HP.
text.flavor: The ground gave you back. Once.
text.passive: Cheat death once per run (25% HP).

lore.flavour: The ground gave you back. Once.
lore.passive: Cheat death once per run (25% HP).
lore.awake: Rise at 50% HP.

text.name: Padded Hide
text.desc: +1 DEF; the first hit each fight lands 2 lighter per copy.

lore.flavour: Soft outside. Softer inside.
lore.awake: Learns the blow: after the first hit, that damage lands 50% lighter all fight.

text.name: Mirror Scale
text.desc: Critical hits against you are reflected in full.
text.nativeText: Fires when an enemy crits you.

lore.flavour: See how you like it.
lore.native: Fires when an enemy crits you.
lore.awake: Also reflects normal hits at half.

text.name: Anvil Heart
text.desc: +1 DEF every 10 strikes you land (max +10).
text.passive: Strikes harden you, blow by blow.

lore.flavour: Every blow forges it harder.
lore.passive: Strikes harden you, blow by blow.
lore.awake: The forge never cools: cap +12.

text.name: Sentinel Bell
text.desc: Each dodge rings +1 DEF for the rest of the floor.
text.flavor: It rings before the blade arrives.

lore.flavour: It rings before the blade arrives.
lore.awake: Each ring also chips 1 damage off the foe.

text.name: Fortune's Edge
text.desc: Luck signals charge the blade: your next strike hits +50%.
text.flavor: Chance, honed to a killing angle.

lore.flavour: Chance, honed to a killing angle.
lore.awake: Charged strikes hit +100% instead of +50%.

text.name: Quickened Pulse
text.desc: Luck signals quicken you: +1 SPD per copy for the rest of the floor (round in versus).

lore.flavour: Fortune runs in the veins.

text.name: Duelist's Oath
text.desc: +4 ATK per copy against bosses, elites and rivals — the oath shatters after 4 floors.
text.passive: +4 ATK vs worthy blood; shatters after 4 floors.

lore.flavour: Sworn hard. Sworn briefly.
lore.passive: +4 ATK vs worthy blood; shatters after 4 floors.
lore.awake: The oath holds: it never shatters.

text.name: Quenched Blade
text.desc: Every 3rd heal tempers +1 ATK for the rest of the floor.
text.flavor: Cooled in mercy, swung in anger.

lore.flavour: Cooled in mercy, swung in anger.
lore.awake: Tempers on every heal.

text.name: Executioner's Coin
text.desc: Once per floor: a strike on an enemy below 20% HP finishes it. In versus: 10% per copy, max 20%.
text.flavor: Heads, it ends. Tails, it ends.
text.passive: Execute low foes, once per floor.

lore.flavour: Heads, it ends. Tails, it ends.
lore.passive: Execute low foes, once per floor.
lore.awake: Executes below 30% HP.

text.name: Wind Anklet
text.desc: +2 SPD per copy.
text.flavor: It hears the arrow leave the string.

lore.flavour: It hears the arrow leave the string.

text.name: Stutterstep
text.desc: Each dodge staggers the enemy: -1 SPD per copy, for the fight.

lore.flavour: They swing where you were.
lore.awake: Staggered foes trip: their next strike hits themselves.

text.name: Momentum Bead
text.desc: Every 3rd strike builds +1 SPD this floor per copy.

lore.flavour: It only rolls downhill.
lore.awake: Rolls every 2nd strike.

text.name: Hare's Drum
text.desc: After a dodge, your next attack comes instantly.
text.flavor: Its beat skips when yours should.

lore.flavour: Its beat skips when yours should.
lore.awake: Ripostes also strike for 2.

text.name: Loaded Horseshoe
text.desc: +5 [[LCK]] per copy; your dodges release luck signals.

lore.flavour: Nailed on backwards, works anyway.
lore.awake: +12 LCK per copy.

text.name: Cat's Whisker
text.desc: First dodge each fight: counter for half your ATK.
text.nativeText: Fires on your first dodge each fight.

lore.flavour: It twitched. Someone paid.
lore.native: Fires on your first dodge each fight.
lore.awake: Every dodge counters.

text.name: Fortune's Debt
text.desc: +10 [[LCK]], but gold gains -10%.

lore.flavour: Luck lends. Luck collects.
lore.awake: The debt is forgiven — no gold tax.

text.name: Tollkeeper's Ring
text.desc: Every kill pays a +5 gold toll per copy.

lore.flavour: Everyone pays at this gate.

text.name: Merchant's Thumb
text.desc: Shop wares and draft rerolls cost 20% less.

lore.flavour: It presses the scale, gently.
lore.awake: The bazaar offers TWO deals per visit.

text.name: Gilded Plate
text.desc: +1 DEF per 50 gold in the purse. No limit.

lore.flavour: Wealth, worn close.
lore.awake: Gold hardens twice as fast: +1 DEF per 25g.

text.name: Ember Cask
text.desc: Relic damage shakes 1 gold loose per copy.
text.nativeText: Fires when a relic deals damage.

lore.flavour: Violence, distilled and bottled.
lore.native: Fires when a relic deals damage.

text.name: Coin Singer
text.desc: Gold gained by relics rings out a lucky note.
text.flavor: Every coin has a voice. It knows the song.
text.nativeText: Fires when a relic pays out.

lore.flavour: Every coin has a voice. It knows the song.
lore.native: Fires when a relic pays out.
lore.awake: Sings for ALL gold, not just relic gold.

text.name: Hex Thread
text.desc: Luck signals lash the foe for 1 per copy.

lore.flavour: Fortune, sharpened to a point.

text.name: Hollow Idol
text.desc: All relic set counts +1; -15 max HP.
text.flavor: It counts itself among your treasures.

lore.flavour: It counts itself among your treasures.

text.name: Famine Bell
text.desc: Enemies cannot heal; your heals restore 1 less.
text.flavor: When it rings, every table empties.

lore.flavour: When it rings, every table empties.
lore.awake: Your heals are exempt from the famine.

text.name: Millstone Pendant
text.desc: +5 ATK; -5 SPD. The weight swings with you.
text.flavor: Strength is just weight you agreed to carry.

lore.flavour: Strength is just weight you agreed to carry.
